details: ts-hyper-utils 1.3.0 is an infostealer, published 2026-04-27 and never removed. It is pinned as an ordinary registry dependency by @devmikets/hyperliquid-sdk@1.9.1 (MAL-2026-14042), whose manifest in the same version also declares a tarball dependency on the typosquat host registrynpmjs.to; from 1.9.2 onward that carrier dropped this dependency and kept only the off-registry URL. It executes from a postinstall hook and on require(), probes 13 paths under $HOME - nine of them crypto-related, including .ethereum/keystore, solana/program and web3/contracts - and uploads matching files to https://rabbylgh.to:8443/upload as multipart/form-data with `file` and `walletType` fields; that host currently has no A record. Versions 1.3.1 and 1.3.2, published two and four minutes after 1.3.0, ship a 64-byte comment in place of index.js and omit the loader, so `latest` is inert while the pinned 1.3.0 remains fully installable - only 1.3.0 is reported here.

files.note: Infostealer, obfuscated with a custom bytecode VM. Loaded via `main` on require().
Loader executed by the postinstall hook `node build-helper.js`.
